      function leadingZeroBits(num) {
        if (num === 0) return 32;
        var count = 0;
        for (var bit = 31; bit >= 0; bit--) {
          if ((num & (1 << bit)) === 0) {
            count += 1;
          } else {
            break;
          }
        }
        return count;
      }

      var encoder = new TextEncoder();

      async function solve(challenge, difficulty) {
        var target = Math.min(Math.max(difficulty | 0, 0), 32);
        var prefix = challenge + ":";
        var nonce = 0;
        var yieldInterval = 1000; 
        for (;;) {
          var data = encoder.encode(prefix + nonce);
          var digest = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", data);
          var view = new DataView(digest);
          var firstWord = view.getUint32(0, false);
          if (leadingZeroBits(firstWord) >= target) {
            return { nonce: nonce, hash: firstWord };
          }
          nonce += 1;
          if (nonce % yieldInterval === 0) {
            await new Promise(function (resolve) { setTimeout(resolve, 0); });
          }
        }

      function leadingZeroBits(num) {
        if (num === 0) return 32;
        var count = 0;
        for (var bit = 31; bit >= 0; bit--) {
          if ((num & (1 << bit)) === 0) {
            count += 1;
          } else {
            break;
          }
        }
        return count;
      }

      function leadingZeroBits(num) {
        if (num === 0) return 32;
        var count = 0;
        for (var bit = 31; bit >= 0; bit--) {
          if ((num & (1 << bit)) === 0) {
            count += 1;

      function leadingZeroBits(num) {
        if (num === 0) return 32;
        var count = 0;
        for (var bit = 31; bit >= 0; bit--) {
          if ((num & (1 << bit)) === 0) {
            count += 1;
          } else {
            break;
          }
        }
        return count;
      }

      function leadingZeroBits(num) {
        if (num === 0) return 32;
        var count = 0;
        for (var bit = 31; bit >= 0; bit--) {
          if ((num & (1 << bit)) === 0) {
            count += 1;
          } else {
            break;
          }
        }
        return count;
      }

      function leadingZeroBits(num) {
        if (num === 0) return 32;
        var count = 0;
        for (var bit = 31; bit >= 0; bit--) {
          if ((num & (1 << bit)) === 0) {
            count += 1;
          } else {
            break;
          }
        }
        return count;
      }

          var firstWord = view.getUint32(0, false);

          nonce += 1;

          }
        }

        if (num === 0) return 32;

      function leadingZeroBits(num) {
        if (num === 0) return 32;
        var count = 0;
        for (var bit = 31; bit >= 0; bit--) {
          if ((num & (1 << bit)) === 0) {
            count += 1;
          } else {
            break;
          }
        }
        return count;
      }

      var encoder = new TextEncoder();

      async function solve(challenge, difficulty) {
        var target = Math.min(Math.max(difficulty | 0, 0), 32);
        var prefix = challenge + ":";
        var nonce = 0;

        for (;;) {
          var data = encoder.encode(prefix + nonce);

            return { nonce: nonce, hash: firstWord };
          }
          nonce += 1;
          if (nonce % yieldInterval === 0) {
            await new Promise(function (resolve) { setTimeout(resolve, 0); });
          }
        }
      }

      function leadingZeroBits(num) {
        if (num === 0) return 32;
        var count = 0;
        for (var bit = 31; bit >= 0; bit--) {
          if ((num & (1 << bit)) === 0) {
            count += 1;
          } else {
            break;
          }
        }
        return count;
      }

      function leadingZeroBits(num) {
        if (num === 0) return 32;
        var count = 0;
        for (var bit = 31; bit >= 0; bit--) {
          if ((num & (1 << bit)) === 0) {
            count += 1;
          } else {
            break;
          }
        }
        return count;
      }

      var encoder = new TextEncoder();

      async function solve(challenge, difficulty) {
        var target = Math.min(Math.max(difficulty | 0, 0), 32);
        var prefix = challenge + ":";
        var nonce = 0;
        var yieldInterval = 1000; 
        for (;;) {
          var data = encoder.encode(prefix + nonce);
          var digest = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", data);
          var view = new DataView(digest);
          var firstWord = view.getUint32(0, false);
          if (leadingZeroBits(firstWord) >= target) {
            return { nonce: nonce, hash: firstWord };
          }

      function leadingZeroBits(num) {
        if (num === 0) return 32;
        var count = 0;
        for (var bit = 31; bit >= 0; bit--) {
          if ((num & (1 << bit)) === 0) {
            count += 1;
          } else {
            break;
          }
        }
        return count;
      }

      function leadingZeroBits(num) {
        if (num === 0) return 32;
        var count = 0;
        for (var bit = 31; bit >= 0; bit--) {
          if ((num & (1 << bit)) === 0) {
            count += 1;
          } else {
            break;
          }
        }
        return count;
      }

      function leadingZeroBits(num) {
        if (num === 0) return 32;
        var count = 0;
        for (var bit = 31; bit >= 0; bit--) {
          if ((num & (1 << bit)) === 0) {
            count += 1;
          } else {

          }

      }

      function leadingZeroBits(num) {
        if (num === 0) return 32;
        var count = 0;

      function leadingZeroBits(num) {
        if (num === 0) return 32;
        var count = 0;
        for (var bit = 31; bit >= 0; bit--) {
          if ((num & (1 << bit)) === 0) {
            count += 1;
          } else {
            break;
          }
        }
        return count;
      }

      function leadingZeroBits(num) {
        if (num === 0) return 32;
        var count = 0;
        for (var bit = 31; bit >= 0; bit--) {
          if ((num & (1 << bit)) === 0) {
            count += 1;
          } else {
            break;
          }
        }

      }

      function leadingZeroBits(num) {
        if (num === 0) return 32;
        var count = 0;
        for (var bit = 31; bit >= 0; bit--) {
          if ((num & (1 << bit)) === 0) {
            count += 1;
          } else {
            break;
          }
        }
        return count;
      }

      function leadingZeroBits(num) {
        if (num === 0) return 32;
        var count = 0;
        for (var bit = 31; bit >= 0; bit--) {
          if ((num & (1 << bit)) === 0) {
            count += 1;
          } else {
            break;
          }
        }
        return count;
      }

      function leadingZeroBits(num) {
        if (num === 0) return 32;
        var count = 0;
        for (var bit = 31; bit >= 0; bit--) {
          if ((num & (1 << bit)) === 0) {
            count += 1;
          } else {
            break;
          }
        }
        return count;
      }

      async function solve(challenge, difficulty) {

        var prefix = challenge + ":";
        var nonce = 0;

      function leadingZeroBits(num) {
        if (num === 0) return 32;
        var count = 0;
        for (var bit = 31; bit >= 0; bit--) {
          if ((num & (1 << bit)) === 0) {
            count += 1;
          } else {

      }
